_note: Authoritative curriculum registry (empty lessons are a valid production state).

metadata.summary: "Breaks down sales as the transfer of belief, not manipulation, and introduces the core skill every business depends on."
"Clarifies the distinction between sales and marketing so students stop using the terms interchangeably."

ORANGE-L1-003.title: "The Customer's Problem Is the Whole Game"
ORANGE-L1-003.author: "Waldemar M. Caban, JD MA"

metadata.summary: "Teaches students to center every sales conversation on the customer's actual problem rather than the product's features."

ORANGE-L1-004.title: "The Sales Funnel: From Stranger to Customer"
ORANGE-L1-004.author: "Waldemar M. Caban, JD MA"

metadata.summary: "Introduces the sales funnel as a map of how a stranger becomes a paying customer."
"Teaches students how to build a clear, one-sentence statement of why a customer should choose them."

ORANGE-L1-006.title: "Why Marketing Without Sales Fails (and Sales Without Marketing Fails Too)"
ORANGE-L1-006.author: "Waldemar M. Caban, JD MA"

metadata.summary: "Shows how marketing and sales depend on each other and neither works alone."

ORANGE-L1-007.title: "Needs vs. Wants: What People Actually Buy"
ORANGE-L1-007.author: "Waldemar M. Caban, JD MA"

metadata.summary: "Teaches the distinction between needs and wants and how both drive real purchasing decisions."
"Introduces the emotional and logical factors that combine when someone decides to buy."
"Teaches the fundamentals of reaching out to someone who doesn't know you yet, without being pushy."
"Teaches students to construct a short, clear pitch they can deliver in the time it takes to ride an elevator."
"Reframes rejection in sales as useful information rather than personal failure."
"Teaches the difference between honest urgency and manipulative pressure tactics."
"Teaches how showing others have already said yes can ethically motivate a decision, without pressure or dishonesty."

ORANGE-L1-014.title: "Follow-Up Cadence: Staying in Touch Without Being Annoying"
ORANGE-L1-014.author: "Waldemar M. Caban, JD MA"

metadata.summary: "Teaches how to follow up persistently without crossing into pestering a prospect."

ORANGE-L1-015.title: "Brand vs. Product: What People Actually Remember"
ORANGE-L1-015.author: "Waldemar M. Caban, JD MA"

metadata.summary: "Distinguishes a product's function from the brand identity that makes people trust and choose it repeatedly."
"Teaches why trying to sell to everyone usually means connecting with no one, and how to define a specific target audience."
"Explains the difference between free and paid ways of reaching an audience, and when each makes sense."
"Introduces content marketing as providing value first to build trust before ever asking for a sale."
"Explains why word-of-mouth remains one of the most powerful and least expensive marketing tools."
"Teaches practical marketing tactics that require time and effort rather than money."
"Identifies the concrete behaviors that build or destroy trust during a sales interaction."

ORANGE-L1-022.title: "Common Objections and How to Hear Them"
ORANGE-L1-022.author: "Waldemar M. Caban, JD MA"

metadata.summary: "Introduces the major categories of sales objections and reframes them as requests for more information."
"Explains why understanding a prospect's timing motivation is essential to closing effectively."
"Introduces how the first number mentioned in a pricing conversation shapes perception of everything after it."
"Examines the ethical boundary between genuine scarcity and manufactured pressure tactics."
"Teaches how to notice verbal and behavioral cues that indicate a prospect is ready to decide."
"Introduces the basics of negotiating a deal so both sides feel the outcome was fair."
"Teaches how to frame a deal so both sides genuinely feel they gained something, strengthening long-term relationships."
"Compares the strengths and limitations of in-person and digital sales approaches."
"Explains how social media functions across the sales funnel, not just for awareness."
"Teaches how to use email effectively for both marketing and direct sales follow-up."
"Introduces customer relationship management as a concept, not a specific expensive tool."
"Teaches how to organize prospects by stage so a seller always knows where their business stands."
"Introduces conversion rate as the key metric for understanding how effectively a sales process actually works."
"Introduces A/B testing as a simple way to make marketing decisions based on evidence instead of guesswork."
"Teaches how to build a flexible sales script that guides a conversation without sounding robotic."
"Teaches how practicing rejection scenarios in advance builds real confidence and better responses."
"Introduces the technique of building agreement gradually through small, easy yeses before a bigger ask."
"Compares gentle and direct closing approaches and when each is appropriate."
"Explains why keeping an existing customer is usually more valuable and less costly than acquiring a new one."
"Teaches how to ask satisfied customers for referrals directly and comfortably."

ORANGE-L1-042.title: "Case Study Application: Pivoting When the Original Plan Falls Through"
ORANGE-L1-042.author: "Waldemar M. Caban, JD MA"

metadata.summary: "Uses a real founder pivot story to teach how a sales and marketing plan can survive a collapsed original concept."
"Teaches how to turn individual sales skills into a repeatable process the business can rely on."
"Reframes sales skill as broadly applicable beyond formal selling situations."

ORANGE-L1-045.title: "Reading a Room: Adjusting Your Approach in Real Time"
ORANGE-L1-045.author: "Waldemar M. Caban, JD MA"

metadata.summary: "Teaches how to adjust tone and approach based on real-time feedback during a sales or marketing interaction."

ORANGE-L1-046.title: "When to Walk Away From a Sale"
ORANGE-L1-046.author: "Waldemar M. Caban, JD MA"

metadata.summary: "Teaches that not every sale is worth closing, and when walking away is the right call."
"Introduces how businesses can grow by partnering with complementary, non-competing businesses."
"Teaches how to re-engage a prospect who stopped responding without seeming desperate or pushy."
"Guides students through planning a simple, complete sales campaign from outreach to close."
"Capstone lesson synthesizing the full Level 1 ORANGE track into one connected framework."
